segments.name: Lithium
segments.description: Produces and sells lithium concentrate products from its integrated mining and processing operations in Brazil to international customers.
segments.evidence: Based on this assessment, the Company concluded that its operations are organized and managed on an integrated basis, resulting in the identification of a single reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling high purity lithium fines and high-grade lithium oxide concentrate to customers domiciled in various countries.
revenueModel.evidence: For disclosure purposes under IFRS Accounting Standards, the Company presents the geographical breakdown of revenues based on the customers' domicile, reflecting the nature and economic origin of its revenue streams.
